name: Vietnam Solar Financial & LCOE Modeling — Payback, NPV, IRR, Avoided Cost Tariff & DPPA
standard: National Power Development Plan VIII (PDP8) + EVN Retail Electricity Tariff Schedule (Decision 2699/QD-BCT) + NREL ATB LCOE Methodology + ISO 50001 (Energy Management)
description: Financial feasibility and Levelised Cost of Electricity (LCOE) validation for solar power investments in Vietnam. Evaluates CAPEX benchmarks in VND/Wp (typical turnkey EPC 10,500,000 - 13,500,000 VND/kWp for C&I rooftop; 9,000,000 - 11,500,000 VND/kWp for ground-mount farm); OPEX assumptions (1-1.5% CAPEX/year for O&M, module washing, inverter replacement reserve); PVSyst annual specific yield (1,350 - 1,750 kWh/kWp/year based on solar resource in Southern and South-Central Vietnam); financial returns (Internal Rate of Return IRR > 14%, Net Present Value NPV, Payback Period PBP typically 4.0 - 5.5 years for commercial/industrial rooftop displacing peak/standard EVN tariff bands).
